pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with moderately defined edges. Flank patches exhibit medium spatial area and quadrangular to pentangular geometries. Neck patches are vertically elongated with smoother pixel gradients at the boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage with consistent pixel thickness across the flank. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent, forming a stable topological graph across the visible torso and shoulder.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D contour with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the dorsal neck line, becoming less pronounced as it reaches the scapular ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal linear mark of lighter pigmentation is visible on the upper mid-flank, traversing one of the larger polygonal patches.
